en.text: To find the rate of change of one quantity in terms of the (measurable) rate of change of another: (1) read the problem carefully; (2) draw a diagram if possible; (3) introduce notation, assigning symbols to all time-dependent quantities; (4) express the given information and the unknown in terms of derivatives; (5) write an equation relating the quantities, eliminating auxiliary variables via geometric properties if needed; (6) differentiate implicitly with respect to t applying the chain rule; (7) substitute known instantaneous values into the differentiated equation and solve for the unknown rate.
